scene: The machine rattles and unlocks three glowing transit gates across the platform.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view of the mossy platform. On the far left, a lit night tram waits with open doors. Left-of-centre, the player in a denim jacket stands next to the vending machine. At the centre sits an open brass service elevator. On the right, an iron freight lift platform awaits.
